title: The Wildlife of India
description: Home to the Bengal tiger, wild elephants, dancing peacocks and the last Asiatic lions — India's wildlife is unmatched. #india #wildlife #tiger #nature

scenes.text: India is home to some of the rarest wildlife on Earth.
The majestic Bengal tiger, found almost nowhere else.
The dancing peacock, India's national bird.
And the Asiatic lion, living only in one corner of India.
A single country, guarding some of nature's greatest treasures.
